summaryText:
Hi,

Here is the end-of-day summary for 9 September 2026.
Total work logged: 10h 55m.

Tickets worked on today:

AEME-6282 — 
  Customers exploited multi-tab checkout to redeem and cancel rewards points on 22 UAE orders. 18 remediated via PC-48490. 4 remain with insufficient GCRM balance — partial redemption script prepared under PC-53503. (45m)

AEME-6499 — 
  5 stuck UAE orders investigated. 4 confirmed COMPLETED per latest comments. 1 order (AE260812-57849665) remains stuck at SHIPPING_REQUESTED with failed partial cancellation. Parallel fan-out investigation launched for DB state and Kibana logs. (35m)

AEME-6540 — 
  Two UAE orders had NorthLadder trade-in devices rejected. Clawback process stuck in RUNNING — Checkout.com declined card authorization for clawback debit. Remediation script not yet created. Awaits user confirmation to proceed with re-trigger. (2h 0m)

GMT-19192 — 

GMT-20796 — 
  Investigation in progress — no RCA file generated yet. Lock file exists indicating an active investigation. Parallel fan-out investigation needs to complete before RCA can be written. (45m)

PC-53768 — Script to copy paymentInfo to clawback PaymentTransaction and retrigger ClawbackProcess
  Not yet investigated — no RCA file exists for this ticket. Ticket requires investigation to determine scope and remediation approach. (1h 0m)

RT-702249 — 
  Investigation in progress — no RCA file generated yet. Lock file exists indicating an active investigation. Parallel fan-out investigation needs to complete before RCA can be written. (35m)

SAHME-3357 — 
  14 ZA orders with SMC errors investigated. 11 remediated after SMC team completed device and product mappings. 3 remain blocked — Galaxy A36 unmapped, invalid identity document, and invalid product ID. Awaits SMC team confirmation to reset via PC-52678. (1h 0m)

SAHME-3407 — 
  Investigation in progress — no RCA file generated yet. Lock file exists indicating an active investigation. Parallel fan-out investigation needs to complete before RCA can be written. (1h 15m)

SAHME-3409 — 

SAHME-3421 — 
  Investigation in progress — no RCA file generated yet. Lock file exists indicating an active investigation. Parallel fan-out investigation needs to complete before RCA can be written. (45m)

SAME-3958 — 
  SA sales report missing affiliate_name and multistore_verificationcode columns. Feature gap in SaSalesReport.groovy — type system and service layer fully support both fields. Code modification requires build and deployment of sapreporting extension. (2h 15m)

SAME-3962 — 
  18 SA-region orders with refund failures under investigation. Parallel fan-out launched for DB state verification, Kibana logs, codebase trace, and reusable PC ticket search. Sub requester awaiting confirmation on auto-refund re-push vs manual refund.

Open tickets:

PC-53768 [To do] — Script to copy paymentInfo to clawback PaymentTransaction and retrigger ClawbackProcess
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

PC-53503 [To do] — Redeem rewards points (partial) for 4 AE orders - AEME-6282
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

PC-53529 [To do] — [SAM-24720] Create DB cleanup cronjobs for SMI cluster
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

SAM-24720 [Code Review] —  Update or create Cronjob for autocleanup
  Todo: Hi ~@email,
   Please find below details : 
SAP incident : https://me.sap.com/cases/002075129500011086542026/overview
Sa

Thanks,
Aryan
